solver: INC_RANS, FDS + MUSCL (Venkatakrishnan), implicit Euler, adaptive CFL; SA fully turbulent; steady solver
frame: x along the chord from the LE (0) to the TE (1), y normal to the chord (up), chord units. The free stream comes in at angle alpha above the +x axis, i.e. (u, v) -> (cos a, sin a) far away; the aerofoil is fixed.

grid.order: row-major, y outer, x inner: element k = j * nx + i (j = y index, i = x index)

encoding.cp: base64 little-endian Int16, Cp = value / 1000; Cp = (p - p_inf) / (0.5 rho Vinf^2) = 2 p in SU2's INC_NONDIM INITIAL_VALUES units
encoding.mask: base64 Uint8, 1 = inside the aerofoil or no data (u, v, cp stored as 0 there), 0 = fluid
encoding.cp_wall: Cp at each outline node, same order as outline

outline_order: closed polyline of the mesh wall nodes: TE -> upper surface -> LE -> lower surface -> (back to TE)
